lines: Atul Hiralal Shah (Investor Selling Shareholder) is selling up to 12,600 shares in the offer for sale, with proceeds up to ₹1.70 crore if all offered shares are sold.
Timing: the call is timely as trading starts March 11, 2026, at listing.
Family link: shares the surname Shah and middle name Hiralal with Bakul Hiralal Shah.
Gain of up to ₹1.26 crore is before offer expenses and taxes; retained stake is an estimate of ₹3.97 crore at offer price. Confidence is medium: holdings found in one section only.
